notes: HB Dive / QB Keep. A two-leg option on the Dive Read alone (run_play_loop.md Section 15, Consumer 2) -- give and keep, no trailing pitch back, so no Pitch Read fires. `resolveDiveRead` reads the dive leg and `resolvePitchRead` returns null on the missing one, the same two-leg shape pistol_read_option and shotgun_4wr_speed_option already use; only two `read_carry` entries are authored, not the three play_instance_data_format.md Section 3 describes. The dive back runs at target_gap; the QB's keep is aimed at the playside C-gap band by the engine itself (`_aimCarrierAtEdge`), not by anything authored here, which is what puts the two legs in genuinely different places. The Spread Option playbook is the only one that reaches it -- Shotgun 4WR plus `allowsOptionRun`.
